notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: נפשי em i laif/breth/hangre bilong bodi, i no 'soul''; bel i holim laik na hangre long Tok Pisin

notes.subject: i weri
notes.rationale: עיפה em i 'weri/lus strong'; KJV/JPS i tanim olsem 'thirsty' long wanem as bilong graun, tasol Hibru i tok 'weri' tasol

notes.subject: ⟨i⟩ hangre long wara
notes.rationale: Hibru i no tokim hangre; KJV tradisen i putim, mi makim hia olsem tok i kamap long Tok Pisin

translation: Mi stretim aut ol han bilong mi i go long yu; bel bilong mi i weri olsem graun bilong yu ⟨i⟩ hangre long wara. Sela.
